name: comp-277
title: Error List Alert
description: A multi-line error notice for forms. A faded red warning circle sits beside a bold heading and a bulleted list of the conditions that failed.
use: A single field has several rules to show at once and they read better as a short list.
avoid: The heading and both bullets are fixed text, so per-field or changing messages need edits.
a11y: The list has proper list semantics and the icon is hidden, but there is no alert role, so it is not announced. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A rounded rectangle with a thin border sits on the dark stage. Inside, a dim red circled exclamation is followed by a bold sentence, then two grey bullet points on their own lines.
behaves: Static: nothing moves or responds, and there is no way to close it.
customise: The heading and both list items are typed into the file; only border, padding and text colours are adjustable from classes.
weight: light: A border, one icon, two short paragraphs and a list.
demo: Heading "Password does not meet requirements:" with the points "Minimum 8 characters" and "Include a special character".
issues: Without an alert role, screen readers will not announce the notice when it appears.
polishWhy: Clear hierarchy and simple styling; a plain alert box with nothing distinctive.
